data.title: 远坂凛 · 悬崖日光下的傲娇宣言
data.action: 双手抱胸立在悬崖护栏前，黑发双马尾在海风中肆意扬起，下巴微扬，虽然脸颊浮上一抹被阳光与羞赧催生的红晕，却依旧带着标志性的自信与好胜神情
data.location: 俯瞰深蓝海湾的高耸白垩纪海崖观景栈道
data.lighting: 炽烈阳光穿透发梢形成金红光晕，海面折射出炫目碎金
data.camera: 动感仰视中景，将海崖的险峻高空感与凛的英气融合
data.mood: 傲娇好胜、英姿飒爽、自信明艳
data.description: 碧海之上的陡峭海崖观景台。远坂凛身穿魔术名门猩红黑缎高腰系带比基尼，双臂抱在胸前傲然迎风。双马尾在烈日强风中烈烈舞动，面对你毫不避讳的注视，她强自绷着威严的大小姐架势，红晕却一路蔓延到了耳尖，好胜与娇羞交织得恰到好处。
promptTokens: rich jewel crimson and black strappy high-waist bikini
black hair tied in iconic twin tails with black ribbons
standing boldly by cliff railing overlooking panoramic sea
haughty confident smirk with blushing cheeks
data.promptProse: Rin Tohsaka standing proudly at the edge of a breezy seaside cliff overlook railing. She dons an exquisite jewel-mage crimson bikini bordered in pitch-black satin with crisscrossing waist cords. Her classic twin tails whip through the radiant sea wind as she crosses her arms and tilts her chin defiantly, trying to mask a flustered crimson blush with haughty aristocratic bravado.
